name: autoresearch-targets
description: Scout a codebase and work logs for autoresearch targets, gate them for causal honesty, calibrate the judges that score them, and frame the survivors as loops safe to run overnight.

interface.shortDescription: Find, gate, and frame optimization targets for autoresearch loops.
interface.longDescription: Four composable skills. scout-targets fans out read-only lanes over a codebase and work logs to nominate optimization candidates with receipts. gates is the shared rule of recognition — seven properties plus a Goodhart pre-mortem that decide whether a target is autoresearch-shaped. judge-panel calibrates a multi-judge evaluator against held-out human labels before it is trusted to score. frame-loop turns one green candidate into a runnable contract, a frozen harness, a loop mode, and a goal contract the agent cannot redefine.
defaultPrompt: Scout my codebase and work logs for autoresearch targets.
Is this metric autoresearch-shaped? Run it through the gates.
Frame this green candidate as a loop I can run overnight.
